annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, and exact minimum characterization of the Section 2 normwise backward-error definition

assumptions: A is a nonsingular square real matrix, represented by bijectivity of its exact matrix-vector action.
The right-hand side b is nonzero.
One shared relative level epsilon controls both the Frobenius matrix perturbation and the Euclidean right-hand-side perturbation.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P16 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P16 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p16_t1_normwise_backward_error_formula {n : Nat} (A : P16Matrix n) (b xHat : P16Vector n) (hA : p16IsNonsingular A) (hb : b != 0) : IsLeast {epsilon : Real | p16NormwiseBackwardErrorAdmissible A b xHat epsilon} (p16NormalizedResidual A b xHat)
formal_statement.plain_language: The normalized residual is attained by a pair of simultaneous relative perturbations and is no larger than every other shared admissible perturbation level; therefore it is the exact minimum normwise backward error.

informal_proof: For the lower bound, rearrange every admissible perturbed solve into b-A*xHat = deltaA*xHat-deltaB, apply Euclidean triangle inequality and the Frobenius action bound, then divide by the positive normalization denominator. For attainment, use deltaB=-b when xHat=0; otherwise split the residual between a scaled residual-by-xHat rank-one matrix and a scaled residual vector in proportions ||A||_F||xHat||_2 and ||b||_2.
informal_statement: Exact Section 2 identity between the minimum simultaneous normwise relative perturbation and the normalized residual.
